en.title: **Product Security Engineer**
en.text:
Responsible for securing web applications and APIs through security assessments, vulnerability management, security automation, and cloud security initiatives.

  • Performing Application Security and API Security assessments across products and releases
  • Validating access control, authentication, authorization, and business logic security controls
  • Driving security automation and supporting Secure SDLC and DevSecOps practices

Focused on improving the overall security posture of products by identifying risks early and enabling secure-by-design development.

en.title: **Product Security Intern**
en.text:
Worked on securing web applications and APIs through manual security testing, API security assessments, vulnerability validation, and security automation.

  • Performed Application Security, API Security, and RBAC testing across multiple product releases
  • Identified authentication, authorization, session management, and business logic vulnerabilities
  • Developed automation solutions to improve security testing efficiency and coverage

Contributed to product security initiatives through release security validation, real-world attack simulations, and secure development practices.

en.title: **Cybersecurity Mentor**
en.text:
Mentored over 300 students through workshops and hands-on labs covering:

  • Secure coding, OWASP Top 10, API protection
  • Cloud fundamentals: IAM, S3 access, and cloud monitoring
  • Networking: IP addressing, VLANs, and routing using Packet Tracer
  • Secure backend flows and version control in full-stack projects

Organized 15+ interactive sessions including live CTFs and attack-defense simulations, boosting engagement by 80% and improving peer code quality by 30%.

en.title: **Bug Bounty Hunter**
en.text:
Actively hunting real-world web vulnerabilities and reporting them responsibly across platforms like HackerOne and Bugcrowd. Specialized in:

  • OWASP Top 10 exploitation
  • Advanced recon, bypass techniques, and logic flaws
  • API abuse and misconfiguration detection

Continuously sharpening offensive security skills through hands-on challenges and platform reports.
